meta.name: Placement check
meta.note: Optional placement check for the Industry Deep-Dive Track (Appendix D.1). Eight sector-neutral questions on the general instruction (core Modules 1 to 10), for learners who skip the core modules. It advises; it never locks any part of the track. ISO 9001:2015 baseline; no 2026 content. Clause tags are unverified until confirmed against the purchased standard.
meta.passRule: Pass when the share answered correctly meets the pass mark (default 80 percent, so at least 7 of 8). The program owner may change the pass mark here.
meta.adviceReady: You are ready for the sector track. Choose any sector and begin with the primer or go straight to the casebook.
meta.adviceReview: Before the sector track, review the core modules listed below. This is advice only: you may still start a sector now, and nothing is locked.

items.stem: A company is setting up its quality management system. What does it look at first to decide what the system needs to address?
options: Its internal and external issues and the needs of relevant interested parties, such as customers and regulators
The number of documents a competitor keeps
Only the list of products it sells this year
Whatever the certification auditor asks for on the day
items.rationale: The system is shaped by the organization's context: the issues that affect its intended results and the requirements of interested parties that matter to it.

items.stem: Who is accountable for the effectiveness of the quality management system?
options: The quality department alone
Top management, who may assign roles and authorities but keep the accountability
The certification body
Each operator, separately
items.rationale: Top management can delegate tasks and authority, but accountability for the system's effectiveness stays with them.

items.stem: A team wants to change a process step to save time. What is the sound first step?
options: Make the change at once and see whether complaints arrive
Make the change only on the night shift
Plan the change: consider its purpose and consequences, the resources and responsibilities needed, and how output will be verified, and record the review
Wait until the next certification audit
items.rationale: Changes are planned and controlled so that the integrity of the system and the conformity of output are kept.

items.stem: A gauge used for final inspection is found to be out of calibration. What else is needed besides recalibrating it?
options: Nothing, once it is recalibrated
Replace the operator who used it
Change the tolerance on the drawing
Assess whether earlier results were affected and act on any output measured since the last good calibration
items.rationale: When a measuring resource is found unfit, the validity of earlier results is assessed and appropriate action is taken on affected output.

items.stem: An operator finds a printed work instruction at the workstation that is one revision behind the controlled system. What is the right response?
options: Remove or mark the obsolete copy, use the current revision, and report how the old copy came to be there
Keep using it until the stock runs out
Write the changes on the old copy by hand
Ignore it if the steps look similar
items.rationale: Documented information is available in its current version where it is used, and obsolete versions are prevented from unintended use.

items.moduleTitle: Operation, Part B: Production, Traceability, and Release
items.stem: Why does an organization keep the identity of each batch, lot, order, or version through its process when traceability is a requirement?
options: To increase the number of records
So that, if a problem is found, it can tell exactly which output, inputs, and records are affected
Because the customer will inspect every label
So that each person's speed can be ranked
items.rationale: Unique identification lets the organization trace output and define the scope of any problem precisely.

items.stem: A result is just outside its limit and the delivery is due within the hour. What happens to the affected output?
options: It ships, and the result is noted for later
The check is repeated until a reading falls inside the limit
It is identified and held, recorded, and released only by an authorized disposition, with the customer's agreement where required
It is scrapped without a record
items.rationale: Nonconforming output is identified and controlled to prevent unintended delivery, and the action taken and the authority are recorded.

items.stem: The same defect has appeared three times this quarter. What does a sound corrective action include?
options: A reminder to staff to take more care
A written warning to the last person involved
Closing the record once the defective item is fixed
Correction of the output, a cause stated as a system condition, an action on that cause, and a later check that it worked
items.rationale: Corrective action deals with the consequences, finds and removes the cause so the problem does not recur, and reviews effectiveness.
